product_wide_rationale: Governs the session landing directory across the session entry route, the session command, and the worktree workflow, so no single runtime Domain owns it.
summary: A managed session runs in the worktree its claim recorded: concord_work_start claims the canonical worktree, moves the calling session, and refuses success unless the directory reads back as the claimed worktree. The launch landing, its candidate read, and the member-Project selector retired; one claimed directory governs session-prepare, and resolution fails closed.
title: The claimed worktree is the managed session directory
